basis: Curated sample for one company. Written with Claude from Infosys earnings-call transcripts filed with the SEC (Form 6-K, Exhibit 99.5), Q2 FY26 to Q2 FY27, plus Screener company-reported figures where marked. Not generated by the app. Q2 FY26 and Q3 FY26 guidance statements were taken from the filed transcript text; those two calls were not read end to end. 'Operating margin' means the company's own definition (about 21%), not Screener's OPM% (about 24%).

promise_vs_delivered.quote: The new guidance is 2% to 3% growth in constant currency terms.
promise_vs_delivered.tested_against: FY26 actual, Q4 FY26 call (23 Apr 2026)
promise_vs_delivered.actual: 3.1% in constant currency, above the top of the October range

promise_vs_delivered.quote: The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
promise_vs_delivered.tested_against: FY26 actual, Q4 FY26 call (23 Apr 2026)
promise_vs_delivered.actual: 3.1%: inside the raised band, near the low end

promise_vs_delivered.quote: Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
promise_vs_delivered.tested_against: FY26 actual, Q4 FY26 call (23 Apr 2026)
promise_vs_delivered.actual: Adjusted operating margin stable at 21%. Guidance excluded the one-off Labour Code charge, so the comparison is on the same basis.

promise_vs_delivered.quote: Our revenue growth guidance of financial year '27 is 1.5% to 3.5% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
promise_vs_delivered.tested_against: Q1 FY27 call (23 Jul 2026) and Q2 FY27 call (23 Oct 2026)
promise_vs_delivered.actual: Cut to 1.5%-3% in July, then 1%-2% in October. H1 FY27 grew 1.9% in constant currency.

promise_vs_delivered.promise: Revised to 1.5% to 3%, including about 1.7% from acquisitions
promise_vs_delivered.quote: we have changed our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms
promise_vs_delivered.actual: Cut again within one quarter to 1%-2%: 'Revenue growth was below our expectations'. Price increases were lower than anticipated.

promise_vs_delivered.quote: Our operating margins guidance for the year is 20% to 22%.
promise_vs_delivered.actual: 21.1% in Q1, 21% in Q2; H1 at the midpoint. Management flags H2 headwinds from wage hikes and softer seasonality.

promise_vs_delivered.metric: Revenue headwind from a large European manufacturing client
promise_vs_delivered.promise: A 0.75% to 1% reduction to FY27 growth
promise_vs_delivered.quote: Reduction of 0.75% to 1% due to lower revenue from one of our large European manufacturing client.
promise_vs_delivered.actual: CFO: the impact is 'now clearly above 1%', and was a further headwind to the revised guidance.

promise_vs_delivered.promise: A similar number to FY26, about 20,000
promise_vs_delivered.quote: We onboarded more than 20,000 freshers in FY26 and expect to hire a similar number in FY27.
promise_vs_delivered.actual: About 13,000 hired in H1 (8,000 in Q2); the target of about 20,000 was kept.

promise_vs_delivered.quote: We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
promise_vs_delivered.actual: 30% in Jun 2026 and 29% in Sep 2026 quarters (Screener); management repeated 29%-30% on 23 Oct 2026.

promise_vs_delivered.quote: This is growing at double-digit Q-on-Q over the last several quarters.
promise_vs_delivered.actual: AI revenue 10.5% of revenue, up 29% sequentially (8.2% in Q1).

promise_vs_delivered.metric: Financial Services and EURS growth in FY27
promise_vs_delivered.quote: we expect acceleration in financial year 2027 over financial year 2026
promise_vs_delivered.actual: Vertical growth rates are not disclosed in the transcripts. EURS took a one-off client termination in Q1. Large-deal wins in Financial Services were above $3.5 bn in Q2.

promise_vs_delivered.metric: Contribution from a new $2 bn+ mega deal
promise_vs_delivered.promise: Over 1% to growth, as the deal ramps
promise_vs_delivered.quote: This deal is expected to contribute over 1% growth for the company in FY28.
promise_vs_delivered.tested_against: Not testable before FY28 (transition starts in the second half of Q4 FY27)
promise_vs_delivered.actual: Not yet visible in revenue. The CEO's remarks referred to the 'coming financial year'; the CFO placed it in FY28.

guidance.guidance: 1% to 2% (cut from 1.5%-3% in July, and 1.5%-3.5% in April)
20% to 22%, unchanged since April; H1 at 21%
Compensation hikes (Oct 2026 and Jan 2027), softer revenue seasonality, sharing of AI productivity benefits, large-deal ramp-up; partly offset by Project Maximus
About 1.7% of the 1.5%-3% guidance (Optimum Healthcare, Stratus), as of July
Over 1% growth; transition begins in the second half of Q4 FY27

narrative_vs_numbers.management_said: Q2 revenue growth was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% QoQ in constant currency; FY27 guidance is 1%-2%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_show: Rupee revenue rose 10.7% YoY, from Rs 44,490 cr to Rs 49,244 cr (Screener). The gap to 1.5% is currency translation; the call itself cites rupee depreciation as a 40 bps margin tailwind.
narrative_vs_numbers.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener quarterly table

narrative_vs_numbers.management_said: Operating margin stable at 21%; H1 at the midpoint of the 20%-22% range.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_show: Screener OPM was 24% in five of the last six quarters and 23% in Dec 2025 (a different definition from the company's 21%). Operating profit rose 11% YoY in Sep 2026 (Rs 11,689 cr vs Rs 10,535 cr).
narrative_vs_numbers.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener quarterly table

narrative_vs_numbers.management_said: EPS up 8.7% YoY in Q2 and 11.7% in H1, in rupee terms.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_show: Screener EPS: Rs 19.28 vs Rs 17.73 in Q2 (+8.7%); H1 Rs 38.43 vs Rs 34.39 (+11.7%). Net profit rose 6.3% YoY in Q2, slower than operating profit.
narrative_vs_numbers.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener quarterly table

narrative_vs_numbers.management_said: Free cash flow was $928 mn in Q2, 113% of net profit. For FY26, adjusted free cash flow was 106% of net profit after removing income-tax refunds and the Labour Code charge.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_show: Screener operating cash flow as a share of net profit: 108% (FY22), 93% (FY23), 96% (FY24), 133% (FY25), 115% (FY26). The FY25 and FY26 figures include one-offs, which management itself adjusts for.
narrative_vs_numbers.source: Q4 FY26 and Q2 FY27 calls; Screener cash-flow table

narrative_vs_numbers.management_said: 'a debt-free balance sheet' with cash and equivalents of $4.7 bn.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_show: Screener shows Borrowings of Rs 8,525 cr at Sep 2026. The table does not split what is in that line, so the two cannot be reconciled from this data alone.
narrative_vs_numbers.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener balance sheet

bull.point: AI-first revenue is now 10.5% of revenue and grew 29% sequentially in Q2; it was 8.2% in Q1 and 5.5% in Q3 FY26.
Large-deal wins were $5.2 bn in Q2 (62% net new), including a net-new mega deal of over $2 bn that management expects to add over 1% to growth in FY28. H1 deal wins were $8.8 bn, up 28%.
Margins held at 21% through the revenue slowdown, and the 20%-22% guidance has not been touched.
Cash generation is strong: free cash flow was 113% of net profit in Q2, and operating cash flow has exceeded net profit in FY25 and FY26 on Screener's figures.
bull.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener cash-flow table

bear.point: Revenue guidance was cut twice in six months, from 1.5%-3.5% to 1.5%-3% to 1%-2%. H1 grew 1.9% in constant currency.
bear.source: Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls

bear.point: Pricing is weaker than planned: price increases came in lower than anticipated amid high competitive intensity and clients' AI-productivity demands.
H2 margins face wage hikes, softer seasonality, sharing of AI productivity benefits and large-deal ramp-up, with Project Maximus only partly offsetting.
Client-specific hits keep appearing: a European manufacturing client impact now above 1%, and a 50 bps one-off from an EURS client termination in Q1. Hi-Tech and Retail were soft in Q2.
Reported rupee growth (+10.7%) is much higher than underlying constant-currency growth (+1.5%), so rupee headlines overstate demand.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call; Screener quarterly table
